test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A retailer offers the following discount schemes for an article to his customers.

A. Two equal successive discounts of 15% .

B. Two successive discounts of 12% and 18%.

C. Buy 7 articles and get 3 free.

Which scheme is favorable to a customer? (assuming buys articles in a multiple of 10)

options.text: Both A and C are the same

solution:
**Formula used**

Two successive discounts x and y 

The total discount = -x-y+(xtimes y)/(100)

**Calculation:**

Case 1: two successive discounts of 15%

Total discount = 27.75%

Case 2: two successive discounts of 12% and 18%

Total discount=27.84%

Case 3: buying 7 articles and get 3 free

let cost price of an article = Rs 1

He got 10 articles with price of seven

Discount=(10-7)/(10)times 100= 30%%

**so the most discount is offered in case 3**
